label: Headless vgpu picture adapter
summary: Render the same EPRS visual score as deterministic offscreen WebGPU frames, then mux the original audio locally for a technical picture candidate.

handoffs.label: Render a score through headless vgpu
handoffs.intent: Exercise a promptable music-video score without a browser window, preserving the score, audio checksum, frame controls, and technical verification for later picture review.
inputs: A song-local visual score and a declared audio derivative
vgpu 0.3.1 installed under visuals/ and a passing vgpu doctor check
Declared title, source rights, renderer setting, and review state
outputs: An H.264 yuv420p progressive BT.709 MP4 with AAC audio at 48 kHz stereo
An eprs.vgpu-render/v1 sidecar and a song-local audio-control manifest
A frame sequence rendered through offscreen WebGPU for local inspection
steps: Run eprs visual-render with --renderer vgpu against the chosen score and audio.
Inspect representative frames and probe the complete candidate locally.
If the candidate is worth keeping, capture it through eprs picture add and review the complete picture before any delivery assembly.
verification: Confirm the score, audio, controls, output, and renderer settings are checksum-bound in the sidecar.
Confirm even dimensions, H.264/yuv420p/progressive BT.709 picture, AAC 48 kHz stereo, and duration within frame tolerance.
Confirm technical rendering does not set creative approval, picture keep, publication, upload, or release authority.

preserve: The original score, source audio, generated frame evidence, controls manifest, output MP4, and complete render sidecar
Open musical space and the declared EAT · PLAY · RELAX · SLEEP visual intent rather than illustrating every waveform event
avoid: Unlicensed footage or photos, silent insertion of faces or model output, overwriting prior renders, or treating a GPU smoke test as picture approval
Using vgpu as a substitute for the approved lossless master, renderer-neutral picture review, or a separately authorized publication handoff
